# Align Self

::: info 实现进度 55% · 进行中
Playground 已 `@source` 文档 markdown，这些类名可在本页示例里跑。未写入 `helpers.css`；SDK 里 schema 动态 class 仍依赖源码扫描。`m:` / `pc:` 只接到间距和宽高。
:::

单个子项覆盖 `items-*`。

```schema
type: page
body:
  - type: tpl
    className: flex items-start h-20 bg-muted p-sm rounded-md gap-2
    tpl: '<span class="bg-card p-xs rounded-md">上</span><span class="self-end bg-card p-xs rounded-md">下</span>'
```

## 类名

| Class | Properties |
| --- | --- |
| `self-auto` | `align-self: auto` |
| `self-start` | `align-self: flex-start` |
| `self-end` | `align-self: flex-end` |
| `self-center` | `align-self: center` |
| `self-stretch` | `align-self: stretch` |

响应式：`m:` / `pc:` 目前只接到间距和宽高辅助类。其它类请用 Tailwind 断点（`max-md:` / `md:`）。状态前缀见 [辅助类-状态样式](/style/state)。
